title: A Snowboard Dream - Relaxing, Endless, Free game with Zero objectives??
author: Fit_Assignment2113
selftext:
I just launched my first game on this website:   
[https://snowboarddream.com/](https://snowboarddream.com/)

**It has 0 objectives**, which may sound weird, but this gives your brain 0 things in the future to fixate on and hopefully, instead brings you into the present moment and a state of flow and relaxation.

**I meant for it to be played for the multiple following reason/scenarios:**

1. Something to play while u listen to something, for example a podcast, an audio book.
2. Something to play for a few minutes while you wait for something else.
3. Something to help get your mind out of a stressful state. Many people might know the situation of knowing you should probably just take a break and do nothing for 10 minutes, but once your mind is in that "more-more-more" state, it seems very unappealing to "do nothing", I'm hoping this game will act as a bridge for you to get out of that state, and into a more peaceful and relaxing state.
4. Whatever floats your boat.

I**t's 100% made by AI**, even the music. Mostly by 6.1 Sol Medium, but had to bring in Astra 6 medium to make the snow trail properly satisfying. The music is all generated by Treblo. Some sound effects were generated using "Stable Audio 3.0 Medium" in ComfyUI locally. It only took about 4 days to make, most of the time being listening to AI generated music to find something proper... do not recommend :p 

I'm very happy to receive any feedback, and especially music suggestions to be added to the game.  
  
I made this game because i wanted it myself, but i hope it also brings you guys some joy.
